scope: deterministic layers (Sigma + anomaly scoring), plus token and citation counts read from 2 saved swarm runs; verdict quality is not evaluated

measured.name: detections from the single noisiest rule
measured.note: rule: First Time Seen Remote Named Pipe

measured.name: ATT&CK techniques observed (v16.1)
measured.note: observed in this corpus run; not a claim about total coverage

measured.name: detection-set fingerprint
measured.note: a47b8da3ac267809e1610d706c3f9b1a...  (re-running on the same corpus must reproduce this exactly)

measured.name: incidents with a saved swarm run
claims that survived citation verification
measured.note: mechanical: every quoted span was found in the finding it cites; this is not a judgement of whether the verdict is right

unmeasured.name: false-positive rate
unmeasured.reason: no labeled ground-truth corpus exists (evals/labeled/ is empty), so no detection can be classified as a true or false positive. The under-10% figure in the product is a TARGET and has never been measured; publishing a rate here without labels would fabricate it.
unmeasured.required_to_measure: a labeled set: one JSONL row per detection in evals/labeled/ with {detection_id, verdict: 'tp'|'fp'} decided by a human analyst reviewing the raw evidence. See labeled/README.md for the schema.

unmeasured.name: true-positive / recall rate
unmeasured.reason: same missing precondition, plus recall additionally requires knowing which real attacks the corpus contains that CITINEL did NOT detect -- absent from any output by construction.
unmeasured.required_to_measure: the labeled set above, plus an independently-sourced list of the attacks present in the corpus (BOTS v1 has published solutions that could seed this).

unmeasured.name: cost per incident in rupees
unmeasured.reason: tokens per incident are measured above; turning them into money needs the per-token price for the two model ids in use, which the harness does not know and will not guess.
unmeasured.required_to_measure: a price per million tokens for each model id, then tokens x price.

unmeasured.name: verdict quality
unmeasured.reason: no human-adjudicated verdicts exist to compare against. The citation count above proves every surviving claim quotes its finding; it does not prove the verdict drawn from those claims is correct.
unmeasured.required_to_measure: an analyst-adjudicated verdict per investigated incident (correct, partial, wrong) in evals/labeled/verdicts.jsonl, decided from the raw evidence, not from the swarm's own narrative.
